Population increased in Great Yarmouth

The estimated population of Great Yarmouth in 2024 was 100,529 usual residents, a rise of 0.3% since 2023.

This meant that Great Yarmouth's rate of population change placed it among the slowest growing 20 percent of local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Great Yarmouth increased by 0.3%.

Over this slightly longer period, Great Yarmouth was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Great Yarmouth

The average (median) age fell to 46.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Great Yarmouth has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Great Yarmouth is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Great Yarmouth's population of 100,529 usual residents was made up of:

  • 17,170 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.1%)
  • 58,417 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.1%)
  • 24,942 people aged 65 years and over, (24.8%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Great Yarmouth has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (24.8% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Great Yarmouth, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Great Yarmouth
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Great Yarmouth, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 476 people (-0.5%). In total, there were 854 births and 1,330 deaths in Great Yarmouth.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 541 (0.5%). There were 4,460 people entering the area and 3,919 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Great Yarmouth's population of 267 (0.3%) as a result of 730 people entering the area and 463 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Great Yarmouth was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Great Yarmouth in mid-2023 is 100,209.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 99 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 45 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 144 people.
